settings.title: A small team building serious infrastructure

settings.editor: Aurora is made in Amsterdam by engineers who spent a decade shipping ML to production and wanted better tools.

settings.title: Shipping AI should feel calm, not chaotic

settings.editor: Aurora started in 2021 with a simple idea: AI tooling should be as pleasant to use as the design tools we already love. Today teams in 14 countries build on it.

settings.title: Numbers your product leaders actually care about
We build the calm layer for AI teams

settings.editor: Fourteen people, one product and a stubborn belief that AI tooling should feel as considered as the design tools we grew up on.
Software about people should feel human, so we write like people and design for calm.
Every claim in our product is backed by an evaluation you can run yourself.
Bootstrapped, profitable and independent - we answer to customers, not to a board.
A small team of engineers, researchers and designers who ship.
Previously product lead at two SaaS platforms.

settings.title: What teams say after a year

settings.editor: No slogans, just what changed after the rollout.
We brought Aurora in for one narrow use case and it became our product infrastructure within a quarter. The built-in evaluations are the difference.
Twelve days to our first production release. Our engineers wrote less glue code and trusted the rollout far more.
Compliance review went from a week to an afternoon. Legal can finally see exactly what the model saw.

settings.title: Ready to ship your first agent?

settings.editor: A 30-minute call, no commitment. Bring one use case and we will sketch the path to production on it.
